reviewFindings: Draft arrows 806/807 show H-803 through RV-801 to PY-801, while General Note 2 names F-801. The concept follows the arrows; document-owner confirmation remains open. Draft AR801 identifies an argon stream, not an approved alias for the model AR-801 manifold.

Draft 1 kg KBH4 per kg rGO, 750 degC, 5 degC/min ramp and 2 h residence are source references only. Draft +2 psig and maximum 10 ppm oxygen are not selected control or protective limits. Feed accuracy during refill, residence distribution, reaction/gas evolution, throughput and product acceptance remain open.

TR-801 and LK-802 are model-added contained-transfer concepts. KBH4 handling remains dry and isolated from indirect cooling water; no process-water wash or common process/utility drain is inferred. Dew point, leakage, materials, capacities and residue handling are unqualified. RV-801 is not credited as positive isolation.

PY-801 normal off-gas runs through E-801 and FN-801 to AB-3801 candidate. Inventory vents use DC-3811; F-802 has its own DC-3812 route. Emergency PSV-801 relief stays separate. The draft mentions a cyclone without an identified symbol/tag; no cyclone is invented. H2/boron composition, treatment performance, relief loads and final disposal remain unqualified.

Sheet is Draft - Not for Use with XXX revision. Oxygen, moisture and hydrogen verification are functional concepts, not qualified sensors or trip logic. PY-801 includes heating, hold and cooling zones; no separate product cooler is invented. A-900 receiving equipment is not modeled. Product temperature, residual reactivity, quality and receiving atmosphere require acceptance.

safeguards.offGasBasis: H₂ 12–35 Nm³/h (30–55 vol % in Ar) with 10–20 kg/h potassium vapour condensing below ≈ 570 °C into a pyrophoric, water-reactive liquid — treat H₂ as a continuous process stream and K/B aerosol as fouling/materials exposure; segregate (S3) from wet vents and from PY-701 CO gas; hot-end K condenser required
